newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH 1997 PRIVATISATION ONSLAUGHT IN Q2.
newsitem.headline: POLISH 1997 PRIVATISATION ONSLAUGHT IN Q2.

text.p: The largest number of Polish
privatisations slated for this year will take place in the
second quarter, a deputy privatisation minister said on
Wednesday.
"The most important period in privatisation (this year)
will be the second quarter because the largest amount of public
offers is cumulated into this period," Piort Czyzewski told
reporters after the government's economic comittee (KERM)
discussed the 1997 privatisation schedule.
KERM accepted and recommended to the full cabinet the
following privatisation schedule for 1997:
QUARTER NAME DESCRIPTION TYPE OF PRIVATISATION
Second Celuloza SA paper firm public offer
Impexmetal SA metal trader public offer
Polar SA appliance maker public offer
Hutmen SA mill products maker public offer
Ciech SA chemicals firm public offer
Bank Handlowy SA bank public offer
*KGHM Polska Miedz SA copper concern public offer
DTC Centrum SA retailer tender
Kruszwica edible fats firm tender
Electrical heating plant Krakow SA tender
Zwar SA electrical firm tender
Romet SA bicycle maker tender
Ruch SA newsstand chain tender
Third Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA (PBK) bank public offer
Polfa Krakow SA pharmaceutical firm tender
Celuloza Swiecie SA paper firm tender
Iskra SA ball bearings maker tender
Ozarow SA cable maker tender
Dromex SA builder and trader tender
Polfa Rzeszow SA pharmaceutical firm tender
Fourth Orbis SA hotel and travel firm public offer
NOTE - tender means an invitation to a tender, * KGHM's
public offering may occur in the third quarter.
